CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Crafts: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Crafts with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.

7. Best practice when working on Athletics and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics and Mosaic.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics and Mosaic.
   C. Practise Athletics and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics and Mosaic.

8. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   B. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.

9. Best practice when working on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Best practice when working on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Practise Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

12. Best practice when working on Rugby: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rugby.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rugby.
   C. Practise Rugby with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rugby.

13. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

15. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and Mosaic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
